title: Separate scalar-admission cost from canonical structural materialization
question: After GPU-12 fused repeated structural CSR validation scans, how much of canonical Boolean TypedRelationBlock construction is attributable to the exact persisted-scalar _stored contract, without introducing a trusted constructor or duplicating structural validation?

change.profiler_schema: Bump the existing contained validation profiler from /1 to /2 instead of creating another benchmark harness.
change.scalar_timing: Measure the exact existing daedalus.twin.relation_blocks._stored(value, 'boolean') scan independently with the same warmup/repeat policy used by the constructor baseline.
change.same_run_attribution: Retain cProfile attribution for TypedRelationBlock.__post_init__ and _stored and report post-init-less-stored only as an inclusive profiler remainder, not as pure structural wall time.
change.semantic_control: Require scalar admission to reproduce the exact Boolean value tuple and require every profiled canonical block digest to match the unprofiled canonical constructor output.
change.test_contract: Pin schema, exact fail-closed scalar semantics, output/call-count parity, attribution fields, non-additivity caveat, and the explicit no-structural-bypass measurement contract.

verification.matrix: Python 3.10/3.12 x PYTHONHASHSEED 0/123456 integrated contract steps succeeded
verification.designated_python_312_hash0: integrated contract surface, packed CPU baseline, TypedRelationBlock validation profile, residency diagnostic, fanout diagnostic, uploads, and public API verification all succeeded

frozen_scalar_attribution_diagnostic.measurement_caveat: Unprofiled scalar and constructor timings are separate measurements and are not additive. cProfile cumulative values include observer overhead; post-init-less-stored is an inclusive attribution remainder, not pure structural wall time. Hosted-run numbers are diagnostic only.

finding.summary: Exact Boolean scalar admission is a material cost that grows with output entries, but it is not the sole or majority constructor cost in the frozen cases: the largest unprofiled case spends about 40.2% of full constructor wall time in an independently measured _stored scan, while same-run cProfile attributes about 27.2% of __post_init__ cumulative time to _stored.
finding.negative_result: The evidence does not justify a trusted constructor or scalar-admission bypass. Even eliminating _stored entirely would leave substantial canonical-construction work, and bypassing it would weaken persisted semiring admission.
finding.next_implication: Keep the canonical scalar contract. The next narrow diagnostic should attribute the remaining __post_init__ self/structural work or compare it against support decoding before proposing any production optimization.
